correctness.rationale: The only normal subgroups are 1, V and G; irreducible fixed-point-free action gives self-centralizing order-q complements. Thus all group-homomorphic local rules either have one full automorphism factor or share a single cyclic image. Finite-field semilinear normalizers count automorphisms as \(p^d d(p^d-1)\); Laurent support counting yields every multiplicity. Scalar linear entropy is credited to the cited 2026 theorem, and the topological entropy of a map equals that of its restriction to its image. The standalone finite checker exhaustively validates three example groups and nine small scalar cases, supplementing the infinite written proof.

value.rationale: This infinite natural family has a sharp and complete joint classification of one-dimensional group cellular automata, their two distinct entropy scales and the exact number of local rules at every entropy for any fixed radius. It distinguishes quotient dynamics from full nonabelian-shift dynamics and goes substantially beyond per-instance entropy computability or a small numerical table.
